Team OrbitX 🚀

We are a group of enthusiastic engineering students passionate about space exploration, technology, and innovation. Our interests include Electronics, Software Development, Coding, and Hardware. We aim to learn new skills, exchange ideas, and develop innovative solutions for space missions. We welcome motivated team members interested in Coding, Software, AI/ML, Data Analysis, and Web Development. Let's collaborate, innovate, and explore new possibilities together!
